TIGR's 'other revenues' line was $21.0M in Q2, +67.6% y/y, with 14 HK IPOs underwritten and $26.3M in Q3 2025. That line is likely flat to up q/q while commissions fall.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No separate reaction history. The line is about 12% of revenue, so its effect is net of the commission decline in finding 1.

findings.finding: Costs are rising into falling revenue. Q2 total operating costs were $103.9M, +46.5% y/y: marketing +86.6%, communication and market data +56.4%, G&A +44.6%. H2 CAC is guided up to $450-550 from about $450, and new funded accounts are guided flat or higher. With Q3 net revenue likely below Q2's $160.7M, operating margin should compress from Q2's 35% (op income $56.8M).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 was sold -7.3% per AllInvestView/Simply Wall St on margin compression from a lower take rate (https://fxnewsgroup.com/forex-news/retail-forex/tiger-brokers-shares-flat-despite-record-q2-2026-revenues-of-160-7m/ reports the flat version).

findings.finding: Positioning is set up for relief rather than for a further leg down. TIGR is at $3.91, +10% off its 52-week low and -64.8% from its high, and down about 20% since the Q2 print while the S&P barely moved. Short interest is modest (about 5% of float, 3.9 DTC) and option open interest is call-heavy (put/call 0.22). The closest peer rose +2.8% on 2026-11-19 on a weak-quarter revenue beat.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: In 2026 the stock has not rallied on prints (Q1 -3.9%, Q2 flat to -7%), so 'cheap' has not paid on its own.

findings.finding: Q3 2026 is the first full quarter under the mainland liquidation-only regime: no new positions or deposits for mainland users from 2026-06-12. Mainland revenue contribution had already fallen to 15-20% in Q2 from 20-25%, and mainland users held under 10% of client assets. Revenue from that cohort should decline further in Q3, and the call will likely disclose a lower share.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The penalty announcement was -28 to -32% on 2026-05-22. The Q2 disclosure of the 15-20% share came with a flat to -7% reaction.

findings.finding: Management reaffirmed a 150K new-funded-account target for 2026. With 61.5K added in H1, it needs about 44K a quarter in H2, against 32.6K in Q2 and a Q3 guide of 'flat or higher' vs Q2. A Q3 print in the mid-30Ks would push the full-year target toward a trim on the call.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No observed reaction to an account-target change at TIGR.

outside_window.finding: Securities class action (class period 2024-04-22 to 2026-06-02) tied to the CSRC notices; the lead-plaintiff deadline is 2026-12-28.

lessons_applied: Rule 2 (one-offs): the tax-normalisation and penalty-tax-reversal finding was cut from +0.4 to +0.2 because it sits below operating income.

Rule 6 (inside the guide): the funded-account target finding was cut from -0.4 to -0.3, because the Q3 'flat or higher' guide already tells the market about 44K a quarter is a stretch.

Left standing: the Futu peer finding at -1.0. 'A peer's print landing after the company last spoke' is a pattern this file says has paid; it is kept small because the bar rests on 1-2 thin estimates (rule 6 cap).
abs_move_pct 6.5 and p_up 46 unchanged: rule 8 and the core's understatement warning argue against shrinking abs_move below the 5.6% implied move.

hunter_view.bar: Company guide FY2026 product sales EUR135-150M, total revenue EUR145-160M, reaffirmed 2026-08-13 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001836564/000162828026056525/a2026_08x13xvlaxh1x2026xpr.htm). Consensus: ~EUR136M product sales, one source, May 2026, snippet only (https://www.marketscreener.com/news/valneva-in-the-green-despite-guidance-cut-and-restructuring-ce7f5bdfd18ff325). No sourced 9M/Q3 consensus, so print_vs_bar_pct (9M product sales ~EUR91M est. vs ~EUR94M implied by consensus and 2025 Q3/Q4 seasonality) is capped and low-confidence; the findings are sized against the company guide.
hunter_view.positioning_check: No US options market (baseline). ADS trades ~10.5k shares/day (~$55k), so it follows Paris (ADS = 2 ordinary shares; EUR2.40 x 2 matches $5.205 spot). Paris disclosed net shorts 2.57% of capital on 2026-11-23 (GSA 1.19%, PDT 0.69%, D.E. Shaw 0.45%, Millennium 0.24%), down from 3.61% on 2026-07-11 (https://www.abcbourse.com/marches/vadposition/FR0004056851). US ADS short interest ~0.2% of float, ~4.5-4.8 days to cover on low volume as of an October 2026 settlement (https://equibles.com/stocks/valn/short-interest). Not a crowded short. Paris stock -8.5% over five sessions and -18.5% over three months into the print, +8.9% off its 52-week low.
hunter_view.baseline_tension: The baseline has no option chain and no reaction history, so there is no market directional statement to agree with; the negative guidance lean agrees with the -7.9% 5-day and -3.8% 20-day run-up (the slide may already hold a cut) and cuts against the name's record of rising on bad-sales prints, which is why p_up is 46 rather than lower.

findings.finding: The US DoD IXIARO supply contract that management said in August 2026 it expected to sign 'in the coming months, with sales recorded in H2' is not visible: the prior DLA IDIQ SPE2DP-25-D-0002 ($49.3M ceiling, $38.4M obligated) closed its ordering period on 2026-01-28 with no successor listed, the follow-on JEV requirement SPE2DP-26-R-0001 (sole source, min 277,760 / max 394,240 doses, 18-month base, 120-day production lead time after each delivery order) was still a presolicitation with the solicitation expected around August 2026, and Valneva, which press-released the 2023 and 2025 DoD awards, has announced none; at the 2025 price (~$164/dose for ~200k doses = $32.8M) the minimum is ~$45M, so a slip of first deliveries past December takes the H2 bridge out of 2026.
findings.source_date: 2026-11-23 (page read; contract last modified 2025-08-25, ordering period end 2026-01-28)
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No 6-K reaction history in the baseline. On the 9M 2025 print (2025-11-20) a 4% revenue miss with guidance reaffirmed was bought +6% in Paris (https://ng.investing.com/news/earnings/valneva-misses-revenue-estimates-reaffirms-guidance-stock-jumps-2220136); on Q1 2026 (2026-05-13) the stock closed green despite a product-sales guidance cut and restructuring. This name has not punished guidance-line bad news on print day.

findings.finding: The reaffirmed FY2026 product-sales guide of EUR135-150M needs H2 product sales of EUR71-86M (H1 was EUR64.0M), against EUR66.9M in H2 2025 (FY 157.9 less H1 91.0) of which ~EUR7.8M was third-party sales now wound down to ~EUR1M a half; proprietary H2 sales therefore have to grow ~18-44% year on year after falling ~21% in H1 (EUR63.0M vs EUR79.6M), in a travel market management called weakening on geopolitical factors.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 2026 guidance cut (EUR145-160M to EUR135-150M) was met with a green close; 9M 2025 reaffirmation +6%. A cut that is widely half-expected has not been sold on the day here.

findings.finding: Bavarian Nordic, the closest listed travel-vaccine peer and the former principal of Valneva's third-party distribution, reported on 2026-11-13 Q3 Travel Health revenue of DKK1,144M, +22% (+32% adjusted for discontinued partnerships), rabies +37%, chikungunya Vimkunya +146%, and did not mention travel-market softness; this lands after Valneva last spoke (Aug 13) and points against a further deterioration in Q3 travel demand.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None measured for this name on a peer read-through.

findings.finding: Pfizer said on its 2026-11-03 Q3 call that the US Lyme (PF-07307405/VLA15) filing has not been made, that it 'continues discussions with the FDA' and 'should provide an update regarding this in Q4 of this year', while the EU MAA was validated in August with a CHMP opinion expected in 2027 and Canada is filed; Valneva's 9M business update (webcast) is a natural venue for that US update, which could be a BLA submission (positive) or an FDA request for more data after VALOR missed its primary CI criterion (negative), and Valneva's August claim of 'regulatory decisions within the next twelve months' is already stretched for the US.
findings.resolves_by: 2026-11-24 (only if disclosed in the 9M update; Pfizer may announce separately later in Q4)
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The VALOR topline (primary criterion missed) took the stock down 36% on 2026-03-23 (https://www.rttnews.com/3633098/valneva-shares-plunge-36-over-lyme-vaccine-phase-3-data.aspx); the EMA validation in August coincided with a ~37% monthly rebound. Lyme news is the largest mover this stock has.

findings.finding: Cost side inside guidance: management guided H2 gross margin 'much better' than H1 and opex down 25-35% vs 2025 after a 15% headcount cut, H1 operating cash use was only EUR13.7M with cash EUR121.5M at June 30 plus EUR6.2M Nantes site sale due to close in September, so Q3 should show a narrower loss and no near-term financing need.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 9M 2025: lower cash burn and EUR143.5M cash were cited among the reasons for the +6% day.

findings.finding: IXCHIQ: the UK MHRA revoked the chikungunya vaccine's marketing authorisation on 2026-10-07 after a benefit-risk review; Valneva says no product remains on the UK market, no recall expense and minimal sales impact, and it is reviewing an endemic-market-only strategy, which leaves room for further IXCHIQ inventory or asset write-downs in Q3 after the H1 IXCHIQ charges (about half the H1 operating loss).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: H1 2026 IXCHIQ charges were reported with guidance reaffirmed; no separable reaction.

findings.finding: Pipeline news already released in November will be restated in the business update: positive Phase 2 Shigella S4V2 results on 2026-11-09 (CHIM met primary endpoint; infant immunogenicity across all four serotypes; Valneva now assumes all further development cost) and IXCHIQ 94% seroresponse at five years on 2026-11-10.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The stock fell over the sessions after both releases; neither moved it measurably.

findings.finding: Disclosed Paris net shorts fell from 3.61% of capital (five funds, 2026-07-11) to 2.57% (four funds, 2026-11-23) while the stock slid 8.5% in five sessions into the print to EUR2.40, 8.9% above its 52-week low.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Prints with bad sales news (9M 2025 miss, Q1 2026 cut) closed up on the day.

outside_window.finding: EMA CHMP opinion on the Lyme vaccine expected in 2027 (Pfizer, 2026-11-03); Valneva regulatory milestones and royalties follow approval.
Deliveries under a new DoD JEV contract carry a 120-day production lead time after each delivery order, so most of the contract's revenue (if awarded) lands in 2027.

lessons_applied: Lesson 1 (reaction function veto): this name closed up on the 9M 2025 miss and the Q1 2026 guidance cut, so the two guidance negatives shrank (-2.0 to -1.5, -1.0 to -0.7) and p_up moved from 45 to 46.
Lesson 5 (proxy smaller): the Bavarian Nordic peer read is unconfirmed transmission and partly reflects Valneva's own lost distribution, so +1.0 to +0.6.
Lesson 5 (drawdown/positioning is the information set): the positioning finding shrank from +0.8 to +0.3; the bought-on-bad-news history moved into reaction_history fields instead.

Lesson 6 (bar): 9M consensus is unsourced, so print_vs_bar_pct is flagged low-confidence and findings are sized against the company guide; left the Lyme/FDA, cost-side, IXCHIQ and pipeline findings unchanged.
Lesson 7: short interest checked (2.57% Paris, not crowded); no change to sign.
